subject: PO header gating and accelerated invoice trigger - procurement constraints and net-term waiver request
messages:
From: Sara Lane <sara.lane@healthgrid.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthgrid.com>, Tim Hartman <tim.hartman@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO header fields + invoice cadence - request for Net90 waiver and accelerated invoice trigger

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to move forward but we have two gating items on our side before legal and finance will issue the official PO:

1) PO header fields - we require the following exact fields on the invoice/PO for ERP matching: PO#, BU Code, GL Account, Project ID, and an explicit vendor tax ID line.
2) Invoice cadence - our standard is monthly consolidated invoices with Net90 payment terms. For this engagement finance needs an exception: they want an "accelerated invoice trigger" that allows us to submit the first two monthly invoices for payment within Net30 if the PO is issued before 10/20. This is a hard constraint tied to a board-approved budget window.

We can accept your standard T&Cs but the accelerated invoice trigger + explicit PO header mapping are non-negotiable. Can you confirm Redwood can (a) include the required PO header fields on the invoice, and (b) accept the limited Net30 acceleration for the first 2 invoices only (after that Net90)? If not, Procurement will ask for a one-time advance prepayment against the first invoice.

I attached a sample PO template from our ERP and a short spreadsheet that shows how our matching logic consumes vendor files.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lane
Senior Procurement Manager, HealthGrid
procurement@healthgrid.com

Attachments: HealthGrid_PO_Example.csv (attached), BudgetWindow_10_2026.pdf (attached)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lane <sara.lane@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO header fields + invoice cadence - request for Net90 waiver and accelerated invoice trigger

Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the sample PO.

Short answers up front:
- PO header fields: yes, we can emit the PO#, BU Code, GL Account, Project ID, and vendor tax ID as discrete invoice lines/headers for ERP matching. Our finance team has done this for several customers — we just need to confirm exact field names to map.
- Invoice cadence / Net30 acceleration: we can support a one-time accelerated payment for the first two invoices, but we need a small concession on pricing to offset the working capital impact.

Proposal: Redwood will accept the accelerated invoice trigger (first two invoices paid Net30) provided HealthGrid includes either:
  A) A 2% prepayment on signing applied to the first invoice as a credit, OR
  B) A 3% reduction (one-time) on the first two invoices combined (applied as a credit)

Either option ensures our cash operations are covered while keeping your requested cadence. If you're not able to do A or B, our alternative is to accept Net90 with a $30k onboarding prepayment.

Next steps: can you ask Procurement to confirm which PO header field labels they will use (exact text) and which of the three payment options (A/B/prepayment) they prefer? I'll loop in finance and legal after you confirm so we can get a PO issued quickly.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0142

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lane <sara.lane@healthgrid.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO header fields + invoice cadence - request for Net90 waiver and accelerated invoice trigger

Sara/Vanessa — looping in finance and the billing SME. Quick context: HealthGrid is requesting a one-time acceleration for the first two invoices (Net30) while their ERP cutover requires specific header labeling for automated matching. We can do both but need a short credit to cover float.

If HealthGrid chooses option A (2% prepayment), our billing team will apply the credit automatically and issue invoices with the exact header label set provided. If option B (3% credit) is preferred, finance needs the PO to include a line referencing "One-time onboarding credit: 3%" so our AR system can route correctly.

Also: to avoid rework, please confirm the PO will contain the exact field names below (case-sensitive):
  - "PO_NUMBER"
  - "BU_CODE"
  - "GL_ACCOUNT"
  - "PROJECT_ID"
  - "VENDOR_TAX_ID"

If Procurement can include that exact mapping and send the signed PO back to billing@redwoodinference.com we can set the accelerated trigger to fire (automatic payment routing) and release the first two invoices as Net30. Please copy billing on return of the signed PO.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
